$comment: KEY · Color Palette · V2 · 2026-05-13. Core 5 + derived scales + semantic tokens + status colors + print metadata. The 5 core values remain locked per KEY Brand Brief v1 §12.

meta.darkModePolicy: KEY does not support OS-level dark mode. Night Navy surfaces are intentional, limited, and never inverted from Paper surfaces. Setting `prefers-color-scheme: dark` MUST NOT swap the public-web Paper background to a dark theme.

status.$comment: Status colors. Never appear as page background or large fill. Used only as: body text inline, small icon fills, badge backgrounds (size ≤ pill), and focus rings.

longFormReadingPreference.$comment: For sustained reading surfaces (KEY Brief body, KEY Letter, /methodology long-form). Preference: Ink 700 over Ink 500 — slightly heavier, less visual fatigue at 17-19px over many paragraphs.

print.$comment: Indicative press values. A printer must pull a wet proof before committing — these are starting points, not contract.

burgundy.note: The four-color build leans purple on coated stock. PMS 1815 C gives a slightly redder, more consistent result and is the safer choice for any Founder Edition or KEY Brief PDF cover. For uncoated stock, PMS 1815 U.

ink.note: Stays slightly off pure K to retain ink-on-paper feel. PMS Black 6 C is the closest match; for richer black on cover stock, request rich-black build 60-40-40-100.

paper.note: Stock recommendation: a warm-white uncoated text stock at 100–120 gsm (e.g. Mohawk Superfine eggshell, GF Smith Colorplan natural white).

navy.pantone: Black 6 C with a 5% PMS 281 C tint
navy.note: Pure CMYK build is acceptable but tends muddy. A two-pass build (black + 5% deep blue) keeps the cool cast of Night Navy on press.

warmGray.note: Hairlines should be specified at 0.25–0.5 pt at press; thinner reproduces inconsistently.

ink700-on-paper.rating: AAA · recommended body color for long-form

ink500-on-paper.rating: AA · use for short secondary type, footnotes

burgundy300-on-paper.rating: AA · large only · for muted accent / revoked states

burgundy-on-navy.rating: FAIL · text · intentional · for stamps/seals only

burgundy400-on-navy.rating: FAIL · text · intentional · stamps + mark accents
